title: Locally scaled kernel screen
hypothesis: Per-sample neighborhood scaling handles heteroscedastic fine-grained class geometry better than a single global RBF bandwidth.
features: Frozen official DINOv2 ViT-B/14 CLS, L2 normalized

kernel.sigma: Euclidean distance to kth nearest fold-training neighbor; evaluation scale uses fold-training neighbors only

selection_rule.reference: standard sklearn RBF SVC C=3 gamma=scale
selection_rule.screen_success: best local-scale arm improves BA by at least 0.50pp
selection_rule.confirmation: Freeze k and beta, then run on two new untouched train-only episodes.
